Why Canadian Brands Manufacture with FABRIOZA

  • 50-piece MOQ: launch or test a style without committing to a container. Most factories serving Canada demand 300–500 pieces per design.
  • Factory-direct pricing: we are the factory in Sialkot, Pakistan — no trading company margin. Typical savings vs Canadian domestic production run 40–55%.
  • Verified standards: export-grade quality management and a documented 4-stage QC process with photo records — the audit trail Canadian retailers ask for.
  • English-first communication with Canadian-morning working-hours overlap, quotes inside 24 hours, and one point of contact from sample to delivery.

Shipping & Import to Canada

OptionTransitBest for
DHL/FedEx express (DDP)4–6 business daysDrops and restocks
Air freight (DDP)8–11 daysMid-size orders
Sea freight (Vancouver/Montreal)32–42 daysLarge planned inventory

Apparel into Canada carries 18% duty on knitwear and 16–18% on woven items, plus 5% GST, as of October 2026. Apparel is excluded from Canada’s GPT preference scheme, so the standard MFN rate applies to Pakistani goods. If your business is GST-registered you reclaim the 5% as an input tax credit, which leaves duty as the only part that stays a cost. Our DDP quotes include both so there are no CBSA surprises. Canadian brands lean on us particularly for cold-weather weights: 400–450 GSM fleece hoodies, lined outerwear and heavyweight streetwear that thinner offshore suppliers struggle with.

Canadian streetwear and athleisure startups, hockey and rec-league clubs ordering custom uniforms, Shopify brands (Canada is Shopify's home turf - stand out with product, not templates), and boutiques building private label collections.

What We Manufacture for Canadian Brands

Team uniforms & sportswear (16 categories), streetwear (heavyweight tees, oversized hoodies, cargo), medical scrubs, kidswear, plus size, menswear, intimate apparel and sustainable/eco garments — all fully private-labeled under your brand. See everything we make.

How It Works

  1. Send your design — tech pack, sketch or reference image. Design mockup within 24–48 hours.
  2. Approve your sample — produced in 5–7 days, shipped to your door in Canada.
  3. Bulk production — 2–4 weeks with 4-stage QC (fabric inspection, in-line checks, AQL 2.5 sampling, photo documentation).
  4. DDP delivery — we handle export, freight and Canadian duties & GST; you receive sealed cartons ready to sell.

FAQ: Manufacturing for Canadian Brands

Do you handle Canadian customs, duty and GST?

Yes - DDP shipping includes the apparel duty and 5% GST with full customs paperwork, so your approved quote is your landed cost. Knitwear (hoodies, tees, sweatshirts, polos) carries 18% duty and woven items 16-18%. Apparel is excluded from Canada’s GPT preference scheme, so the standard MFN rate applies. If your business is GST-registered you reclaim the 5% GST as an input tax credit. Rates current as of October 2026.

How long does shipping to Canada take?

Express courier 4-6 business days; total from sample approval to delivery is typically 3.5-5 weeks. Sea freight to Vancouver or Montreal runs 32-42 days for container-scale orders.

Can you make heavyweight winter garments?

Yes - 400-450 GSM fleece hoodies, sherpa-lined pieces, puffer vests and windbreakers are core products for our Canadian clients.

What is the minimum order quantity?

50 pieces per style per colorway. Test small, reorder winners in 2-4 week production cycles.

Do you work in French?

Production communication is in English; for Quebec brands we support French care-label and packaging requirements (bilingual labels) as part of private labeling.
